title: Meeting processing
description: How transcript segments reach a transcript Lambda hook, and when and how far back meetings that were never ended are looked for. The defaults are the values the stack was deployed with; a value set here is used instead until it is reset.
appliesText: A saved change applies within about five minutes.

transcriptHookNonPartialOnly.title: Send only finished segments to the transcript Lambda hook
transcriptHookNonPartialOnly.description: Applies only when the stack names a transcript Lambda hook (TranscriptLambdaHookFunctionArn). Off sends partial segments too. Default: the TranscriptLambdaHookFunctionNonPartialOnly stack parameter.

inactiveMeetingLookbackDays.title: Days to look back for meetings that were never ended
inactiveMeetingLookbackDays.description: How far back the inactive-meeting reaper looks for meetings to close. A meeting that started earlier than this is never closed automatically. Applies only when the stack runs the reaper (MeetingInactivityTimeoutInMinutes above 0). Default: the MeetingInactivityLookbackInDays stack parameter.

inactiveMeetingTimeoutMinutes.title: Minutes without speech before a meeting is ended
inactiveMeetingTimeoutMinutes.description: How long a meeting may go without a finished transcript segment before the inactive-meeting reaper ends it on its behalf; 0 leaves such meetings open. Keep it longer than the longest quiet stretch your meetings have. The reaper exists only when the MeetingInactivityTimeoutInMinutes stack parameter is above 0, so on a deployment where it is 0 this setting has no effect. Default: that stack parameter.
